title: Haii!!!
heading: Welcome to The Duckpond!
paragraphs: The Duckpond is a place where ducks come to quack, play games, and chill.
Feel free to poke around the site and maybe even join the Discord.

title: ⚠️ Help and Swag 😎 Information
paragraphs: This website is based on a Windows PC and thus is best experienced on a computer.
You can reorganize the windows by clicking and dragging their heading.
If you are on mobile or your screen width is too small, then you cannot drag any windows.
Double click a desktop icon to open it.
If the windows are too messed up for your liking, simply refresh the page and they will return to their original positions.
